title: Sell Mineral Rights in Clearview, WV
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Clearview, WV | Ohio County
metaDescription: Clearview, WV in the Wheeling suburbs sits over old Ohio County mineral tracts. We buy fractional interests and legacy leases directly, no obligation.
heroLead: Clearview sits within Ohio County's cluster of small Wheeling-area communities, where farmland mineral rights were commonly reserved out of deeds decades before the surrounding hillsides filled in with housing.
intro: Ohio County is small and largely urbanized around Wheeling, which means undeveloped mineral-producing acreage is scarcer here than in the wider rural counties to the south. What that acreage lacks in size, it makes up for in ownership complexity: tracts that were part of larger farms now sit fragmented among heirs who left the area generations ago.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Clearview directly, tracing the original farm tract description through the deed record before making an offer.

sections.heading: A small county with a long deed history
paragraphs: Ohio County's records at the courthouse in Wheeling go back well over a century. Clearview-area tracts often show multiple conveyances, partial sales, and reservations layered over that span, which we work through to confirm current ownership.

sections.heading: Leasing activity in a compact county
paragraphs: Fewer new units form in Ohio County each year compared to Marshall or Harrison County simply because there's less open acreage left to develop. That makes it worth confirming whether an existing lease or unit order already reaches your Clearview tract rather than assuming it's untouched.

sections.heading: Heirs who left the Wheeling area
paragraphs: As Wheeling's population shifted over the decades, families who once owned Clearview-area farmland scattered elsewhere. Mineral interests here are frequently held by people with no current connection to Ohio County at all, unaware the interest still exists.

We work with these out-of-area owners routinely, verifying the tract and current ownership from West Virginia records so a seller in another state doesn't have to make a trip back to confirm anything in person.

faqs.question: Is there much active gas leasing in Ohio County?
faqs.answer: Less new development than in neighboring counties, since Ohio County has less open acreage, but existing leases and units still generate royalty. We check current status for your specific tract.

faqs.question: My family left the Wheeling area decades ago. Can I still confirm we own minerals near Clearview?
faqs.answer: Yes, we trace the deed record using your family name and the tract description to confirm current ownership.

faqs.question: How old are typical Clearview-area leases?
faqs.answer: It varies widely, from early twentieth-century flat-rate leases to more recent Marcellus-era agreements. We review the specific recorded lease on your tract.

faqs.question: Can you handle the whole process if I'm not able to travel to West Virginia?
faqs.answer: Yes, we manage the title work and closing paperwork remotely and can coordinate signing and recording without requiring you to be present in Ohio County.
